_: Komentajarivit, joille kirja ei anna Ld-arvoa rivin otsikossa tai rivin omassa tekstissa. Sivu + verified, kuten optiot.json. build_data.py hylkaa buildin, jos komentajalta puuttuu seka jasennetty etta kuitattu leadership. rerolls_scope / rerolls_unit (5.10.2026): kirjan oma rajaus sisaltyvalle re-rollille - kenen heittoihin sen saa kayttaa tai etta se on vuorokohtainen. Lyhyt englanninkielinen ilmaus, jonka sovellus tulostaa maaran peraan; kirjan lause on why-kentassa.

commanders.label: Lord Admiral Rath (Ld10)
commanders.why: s.48: 'Admirals get one Fleet Commander re-roll included in their points cost (Lord Admiral Rath has two)' ja 'Lord Admiral Rath is Ld 10 and comes with two re-rolls as part of his point cost'. Osion yleislause antaisi yhden (pistokoe 9 rivi 38).

commanders.label: Space Marine Captain
commanders.why: s.100: ei Ld-arvoa; 'Space Marine Captains roll against the Space Marines leadership table instead of the normal leadership table'. Kortin LEADERSHIP jaa kasin taytettavaksi.

commanders.label: Farseers
commanders.why: s.318: 'gives the vessel a re-roll which may be used on itself, another capital ship in the same squadron or an escort squadron within 15 cm'; ei Ld-arvoa. Rajaus samasta lauseesta: 'may be used on itself, another capital ship in the same squadron or an escort squadron within 15 cm'.
commanders.rerolls_scope: own ship, its squadron or an escort squadron within 15 cm

commanders.label: Prince Yriel
commanders.why: s.319: 'He has one re-roll as part of his point cost, but a second or third re-roll can be purchased at +25 points each'; Ld-arvoa ei anneta (otetaan Heron sijaan).

commanders.label: Ork Warlord
commanders.why: s.365: 'Warlords get one re-roll. They can have up to two more re-rolls'; ei Ld-arvoa (orkien Ld tulee aluksesta, s.358).

commanders.label: Ork Warlord
commanders.why: s.366: 'Warlords get one re-roll'; ei Ld-arvoa.

commanders.label: Ork Warlord
commanders.why: s.372: 'Ork Warlord ... Free. A Warlord has one re-roll, and may purchase one or two more'; ei Ld-arvoa. Rajaus s.372: 'A Warlord's re-rolls only count for the skwadrons under his command and not for the whole fleet.'

commanders.label: Ordo Xenos Inquisitor Lord
commanders.why: s.141: 'The ship adds +1 to its leadership (max. 10).' Lause puuttuu poimitusta osiotekstista (lists.py), joten se kirjataan tahan kirjasta; Hereticus (s.140) ja Malleus (s.142) jasentyvat omasta tekstistaan.

commanders.label: Kor’O’Mesme* (Ld 9)
commanders.why: s.453 dossier: 'KOR'O VASH'YA Y'ELDI MESME: 110 PTS ... Leadership: 9, Re-rolls: 2'. Listarivi (s.456) antaa Ld 9:n otsikossa; sisaltyvat re-rollit vain dossierissa. Pistokoe 4 (10.9.2026) rivi 35.

commanders.label: Veteran Captain (Ld +1)
commanders.why: s.38: 'A Veteran Captain gets one re-roll which is included in their points cost and can only be used on their own vessel or another vessel in their own squadron.' Ld +1 rivin otsikosta.

commanders.rerolls_scope: own vessel or its Rogue Trader escort squadron

commanders.label: Abaddon (Ld 10)
commanders.why: s.234: 'Abaddon receives one re-roll per turn'; s.231: 'Re-rolls: 1 per turn.' ja 'Abaddon's fleet is allowed to re-roll a single Command check or Leadership test each turn.' Maara on yksi, mutta joka vuoro - ei kerran pelissa kuten muiden komentajien (s.11). Ld 10 rivin otsikosta.
